stories.headline: Malawi Spends Over $700 Million On Fuel While Tobacco Earns Less Than $400 Million As Forex Crisis Worsens
stories.summary: Malawi spends over $700 million annually on fuel imports, while earning less than $400 million from tobacco exports. This massive forex gap is exacerbating the country's foreign exchange crisis. Reserve Bank of Malawi officials, including deputy governor Henry Mathanga, have highlighted the issue, stating that the significant difference between fuel import costs and tobacco export earnings is a major concern. Recently, the government used $30 million from gold sales to pay fuel suppliers, sparking concerns about the country's forex desperation. The situation has led to a worsening fuel crisis, with the government struggling to manage its foreign exchange reserves and meet its fuel import obligations. The forex gap has significant implications for Malawi's economy, underscoring the need for urgent measures to address the crisis.

stories.headline: Six South Africans among 430 activists aboard Gaza flotilla ‘PR stunt’ heading to Israel
stories.summary: A flotilla of ships carrying 430 activists, including six South Africans, is heading to Israel as part of a mission to deliver aid to Gaza. The Global Sumud Flotilla vessels aim to breach Israel's blockade of the Palestinian territory, which has been in place since 2007. High-profile figures, such as Ambassador Faizel Moosa, are among the activists. Israel's Foreign Ministry announced that the flotilla's journey "has come to an end" and that the activists are being transferred to Israel. Some have already arrived at Ashdod port, where they are being held. Israel controls all entry points into Gaza, and this is the latest in a series of attempts by activists to deliver aid to the territory. The Israeli authorities have intercepted previous convoys, and it is unclear what will happen to the current group of activists.

stories.headline: ADHA launches standards framework
stories.summary: The Australian Digital Health Agency (ADHA) launched its National Framework for Digital Health Standards at the Digital Health Festival in Melbourne. The framework includes the Standards Academy, a learning hub offering hands-on training and resources for professionals to build knowledge and skills in digital health standards. This initiative aims to ensure consistent and effective use of standards throughout Australia's healthcare system. Meanwhile, the American Dental Hygienists' Association (ADHA) has adopted ten new and updated policies for fiscal year 2025-2026, affecting scope of practice, education, and licensure. These policies advance accreditation standards, clinical assessment, workforce well-being, and disability inclusion. The American ADHA has also launched the 2025 Standards for Clinical Dental Hygiene Practice, marking the first comprehensive update since 2016. These developments demonstrate a commitment to evidence-based practice and improved healthcare standards.

stories.headline: Open Call: Global Research Collaborations 2026 (Denmark) Deadline: 03-Sep-2026
stories.summary: The Global Research Collaborations programme in Denmark is accepting applications for international scientific cooperation. The deadline for submission is September 3, 2026. Danish research institutions can apply as lead applicants in collaboration with a research partner from selected focus countries. The programme aims to promote advanced research and strengthen global partnerships. Funding of up to DKK 2,550,000, excluding overhead, is available for research projects. Another opportunity with a deadline of June 2, 2026, offers up to DKK 5,000,000 for interdisciplinary research projects. Eligible fields include interdisciplinary research, with various focus countries and collaboration partners eligible to participate. The programme is designed to support open international collaboration and promote scientific advancement. Applications are currently being accepted, with specific guidelines and requirements outlined for eligible institutions and researchers.

stories.headline: Samsung and Google Give First Look at New Intelligent Eyewear Created in partnership with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker, the new intelligent eyewear combines AI with everyday wearability
stories.summary: Samsung Electronics and Google unveiled new intelligent eyewear at Google I/O 2026, showcasing two premium styles created in partnership with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker. The eyewear combines AI with everyday wearability, enabling users to access navigation assistance and manage daily tasks. According to Shahram Izadi, Vice President and GM of Android XR at Google, intelligent eyewear represents a significant step forward in making AI more accessible in everyday life. The collaboration aims to make AI more helpful and integrated into daily activities. The new intelligent eyewear offers a unique blend of style and functionality, marking a notable development in the field of wearable technology. The partnership between Samsung, Google, Gentle Monster, and Warby Parker brings together expertise in technology, fashion, and innovation.

stories.headline: Innodisk Launches High-Speed 10GbE LAN Series to Power Next-Generation Edge AI Networking
stories.summary: Innodisk has launched its High-Speed 10GbE LAN Series, a portfolio of LAN modules designed to address the growing networking demands of edge AI applications. The series comes in M.2 and PCIe form factors, delivering high-throughput, low-latency connectivity with support for DPDK, PTP, and SR-IOV. This enables efficient processing for data-intensive workloads in space-constrained environments. The 10GbE LAN Series is powered by Intel E610/X710 Ethernet controllers and supports DPDK 25.07/DPDK 16.11. The launch aims to tackle the challenges of traditional 1GbE connectivity, which struggles to support real-time data processing, high-resolution video streaming, and multi-sensor integration. The new series provides a solution for edge AI applications, offering performance, compact form factors, and deployment flexibility to build efficient, high-speed systems.

stories.headline: Android 17 adds Continue On, a new feature that lets users move active tasks between Android phones and tablets
stories.summary: Android 17 introduces a new feature called "Continue On" that allows users to move active tasks between Android devices, specifically from phones to tablets. This feature enables seamless transition of tasks, such as browsing a website in Chrome, from one device to another. The devices must be connected to the same Google account to use Continue On. When a user starts a task on their phone, a Handoff Suggestion will appear on their tablet, allowing them to continue where they left off. Although designed to be bidirectional, the feature currently only supports phone-to-tablet handoffs. Continue On aims to enhance the user experience by providing a convenient way to switch between devices and pick up where they left off. The feature is available on Android 17 devices, including Google Pixel phones and tablets.

stories.headline: Sony Launches 1000X THE COLLEXION Premium Headphones and WH Sony unveils 1000X THE COLLEXION premium noise cancelling headphones and the new WH-1000XM6 Sandstone colourway in Australia, celebrating 10 years of the iconic
stories.summary: Sony has launched the 1000X THE COLLEXION premium noise-cancelling headphones in Australia, priced at $999.95, as part of the company's 10th anniversary celebration for the 1000X series. The COLLEXION features premium materials, upgraded sound tuning, and advanced noise-cancellation technology. Additionally, Sony has introduced a new Sandstone colourway for the WH-1000XM6 headphones, available in Australia for $699.95. The 1000X THE COLLEXION boasts improved sound quality, surpassing that of the WH-1000XM6. The launch marks a decade since the introduction of the iconic 1000X series, with the COLLEXION representing a significant upgrade in terms of materials, sound, and technology. The new headphones are now available for purchase in Australia, offering consumers a high-end audio experience with advanced noise-cancellation capabilities.

stories.headline: Aston Villa: I'm no Euro king claims Emery as he goes for fifth Europa League crown
stories.summary: Aston Villa manager Unai Emery is downplaying his European success ahead of the Europa League final against Freiburg on Wednesday. Emery has already won a record four Europa League titles and is seeking his fifth crown. This will be his sixth European final, with only Giovanni Trapattoni having managed more, with seven. Emery's pursuit of success is driven by a desire for perfection. Aston Villa's season had a poor start, with no wins in their first six matches, but they have since turned it around under Emery's leadership. The team will face Freiburg, with Villa's Pau Torres having previously won the Europa League under Emery at Villarreal in 2021. Emery's experience and success in European competitions make him a strong contender to lead Aston Villa to victory.

stories.headline: Southampton set to appeal play-off expulsion Saints have been thrown out of the play-offs after admitting they spied on three clubs during the Championship season.
stories.summary: Southampton has been expelled from the Championship play-offs after admitting to spying on three opposing teams, including Middlesbrough, during the season. The club will also receive a four-point deduction for next season. An independent disciplinary commission handed down the severe penalty after Southampton admitted to three counts of spying. As a result, Middlesbrough will face Hull City in the play-off final. Southampton plans to appeal the punishment, citing concerns that expulsion would alter the sporting outcome of the season, impacting promotion to the Premier League and estimated revenues exceeding £100m. The appeal will determine the final outcome of the situation. The expulsion has significant consequences for the club and the league, with potential effects on sponsorship obligations and team standings.

stories.headline: Women's T20 World Cup: England's questions before tournament Fitness, selection and form are some of the questions England must answer with six games to go before the T20 World Cup begins.
stories.summary: England's women's cricket team faces questions about fitness, selection, and form ahead of the T20 World Cup, with only six games remaining before the tournament begins on February 10, but actually starts on June 12, in England. The team has not played in the T20 format since July last year, making it challenging to predict their lineup. Head coach Charlotte Edwards has included Gibson in the 15-player squad, indicating a positive sign for the team. England will host the tournament, and with the start date approaching, the team needs to address their concerns to be well-prepared. The T20 World Cup will commence on June 12, and England aims to resolve their issues before the tournament starts.

stories.headline: Is your star safe? The two players at your club in the Devils’ sights Now that the list and trade details for the AFL’s 19th club have been confirmed, Tasmania can soon begin raiding talent from rival clubs.
stories.summary: The Tasmania Devils, the AFL's 19th club, can now begin recruiting talent from rival clubs. With the list and trade details confirmed, the Devils have a range of targets to choose from. The club is expected to raid rival teams for top players, leaving fans wondering if their star players are safe. The Devils' recruitment plans are underway, and they have identified key targets from various clubs. Fans of existing AFL teams, including Hawthorn, are watching with interest as the Devils prepare to enter the competition. The club's recruitment strategy is likely to have a significant impact on the AFL landscape, with several players potentially switching teams. The Devils' arrival is set to shake up the league, and fans are eagerly awaiting the outcome of their recruitment efforts.

stories.headline: India heatwave news, el nino heat wave Health advisories issued by the government and doctors include the need for hydration, limiting outdoor exposure during peak hours, and watching for heatstroke
stories.summary: India is experiencing a severe heatwave, with temperatures expected to remain above 40°C in Delhi and surrounding regions. Health advisories have been issued, emphasizing the need for hydration, limiting outdoor exposure during peak hours, and watching for heatstroke symptoms. Farmers in rural areas are also combating heat stress on crops and livestock. The heatwave is attributed to the potential strongest El Niño event in 140 years, with climate assessments showing a steady rise in heatwave frequency, duration, and intensity in India. Authorities have introduced measures such as rest hours for outdoor workers and water facilities in public spaces. The government and doctors are advising people to stay hydrated, wear loose clothing, and avoid outdoor exposure during peak heat hours to prevent heat-related illnesses. Dust storms and gusty winds are adding to the disruption, increasing risks to infrastructure and daily life.

stories.headline: 'Hanged using gymnastic ring rope': Blunt injuries found on Twisha Sharma’s body; what autopsy report revealed
stories.summary: A post-mortem examination of 33-year-old Twisha Sharma, who died in Bhopal, revealed that the cause of death was antemortem hanging using a gymnastic ring rope. The autopsy report also showed blunt-force injuries on her body. Twisha's family alleges harassment, while the accused's family denies the claims. The investigation into her death is ongoing, with police examining the circumstances surrounding the incident. The autopsy report has sparked further investigation and conflicting claims from the families involved. The case is being closely monitored, with authorities working to determine the events leading up to Twisha's death. The presence of blunt-force injuries has raised questions about the events preceding her death, and police are continuing to gather evidence and interview those involved.

stories.headline: PM Modi, Meloni in Rome: Car ride, dinner and Colosseum visit ahead of talks
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni in Rome as part of his five-nation diplomatic tour. The two leaders shared a dinner meeting and went for a car ride, adding a personal touch to their high-level engagement. They also visited the iconic Colosseum together. These interactions took place ahead of their formal talks, which are expected to cover various aspects of bilateral relations. The meetings and shared activities showcased the warm relations between the two leaders and set a positive tone for their discussions. The visit is part of Modi's diplomatic tour, aiming to strengthen ties with European nations. The talks between Modi and Meloni are expected to focus on areas of mutual interest and cooperation.

stories.headline: ‘Completely false, fabricated’: TMC responds to ‘leaked’ municipal notice to MP Abhishek Banerjee
stories.summary: The All India Trinamool Congress has denied reports that party MP Abhishek Banerjee received notices from the Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) regarding properties allegedly linked to him and his family. The KMC allegedly sent notices to 17 addresses linked to Banerjee for unauthorised construction. However, the Trinamool Congress dismissed these claims as "completely false" and "fabricated". The notices were reportedly sent to properties linked to Leaps and Bounds Private Limited, a company founded by Abhishek Banerjee, to demolish unauthorised constructions. The Trinamool Congress has strongly denied the reports, calling them baseless and fabricated, amid an intensifying political row in Bengal. The party's statement comes after the alleged notices were leaked, sparking a controversy surrounding Abhishek Banerjee's properties.

stories.headline: Hong Kong market surge, geopolitics drive ‘fear of missing out’ among French investors Finance chief Paul Chan says the shift is fuelled by city’s strong market performance and an improved geopolitical situation, especially following Xi-Trump summ
stories.summary: Hong Kong's strong market performance and improved geopolitical situation are driving a "fear of missing out" among French investors. Finance chief Paul Chan attributes the shift to the city's robust market and easing geopolitical tensions, particularly after the Xi-Trump summit. The meeting has boosted investor confidence, leading to a surge in the Hong Kong market. Equity markets have been performing well in 2026, with investors largely ignoring geopolitical and macroeconomic concerns. The improved relations between the US and China, with Trump urging China to open up its economy, have also contributed to the positive sentiment. As a result, French investors are increasingly eager to participate in Hong Kong's market, fearing they will miss out on potential gains if they do not invest.

stories.headline: Two Inflation Charts You Can't Ignore Expect a new inflation wave from energy, food, and geopolitics. Read the full analysis here.
stories.summary: Global inflation is expected to rise due to energy, food, and geopolitical factors. The ongoing closure of the Strait of Hormuz has deepened the global energy crisis, driving up inflation. Higher energy costs are acting as a tax on consumers and non-energy businesses worldwide. The conflict in Ukraine and tariffs are also contributing to inflationary pressures. The Federal Reserve is faced with a dilemma, as market expectations of 4-5 rate cuts may not be feasible if inflation continues to rise. The market is caught between strong tech earnings and the new wave of uncertainty, with US consumer sentiment remaining low. The combination of rising inflation and slower growth has raised concerns about stagflation, making it challenging for the Fed to navigate its monetary policy.

stories.headline: No other headlines are provided to select from, only two are given
stories.summary: Customs has handed over stolen luxury vehicles smuggled from Canada. The vehicles include a Rolls-Royce and a Lamborghini, among others. These high-end cars were seized after being smuggled into the country. The handover is part of efforts to combat smuggling and recover stolen goods. The smuggled vehicles were recovered in an operation aimed at curbing illegal importation. The Rolls-Royce and Lamborghini are among the luxury items that have been recovered and handed over. The operation is a significant step in the fight against smuggling and theft. The recovery of these stolen vehicles demonstrates the effectiveness of customs enforcement in combating illegal activities. The handover of the vehicles is expected to serve as a deterrent to smugglers and thieves. Further details on the operation and the handover have not been disclosed.

stories.headline: Congress and regional parties face growing pressure from BJP’s expanding dominance
stories.summary: Congress and regional parties in India are facing growing pressure due to the expanding dominance of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Regional parties that directly compete with the BJP are under significant pressure, as seen in Telangana where the Congress defeated the regional BRS party in December 2023. The Janata Dal (Secular) is playing a secondary role to the BJP in Karnataka's Opposition, while the JD(U) appears vulnerable after Nitish Kumar's shift from the CM's office to the Rajya Sabha. This pressure may force regional parties to either accept Congress's leadership or align with the BJP, as the BJP's centralized narrative continues to gain strength in India's political landscape. The shifting dynamics are altering the role of regional parties, which were once key players in coalition-era politics.

stories.headline: The INDIA bloc’s biggest challenge is that it still lacks a settled answer to a basic question: is it merely an anti-BJP platform, or a genuine long-term political alternative
stories.summary: The Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA), a 28-party opposition bloc, faces a challenge in defining its purpose beyond being an anti-BJP platform. The bloc, formed in the run-up to the 2024 general elections, recently announced a boycott of 14 journalists and channels accused of being biased towards the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). The opposition alliance is led by the Congress, with Rahul Gandhi positioning himself as the principal national alternative to the BJP. However, the bloc's unity is tested by competing strategies and regional interests, with some state units viewing INDIA allies as rivals. The Congress's central leadership seeks a national anti-BJP front, while state units prioritize local interests, highlighting the need for a settled answer on the bloc's long-term goals. The INDIA alliance's cohesion will be crucial in the upcoming elections.

stories.headline: As BJP Targets ‘Regionals’, Can Cong Get Act Together?
stories.summary: The BJP is focusing on the Congress Party, rather than regional parties, in its game plan. The ruling party believes regional parties have become fiefdoms of their leaders, driven by self-interest. Most electoral battles in 2027-28 will be between the BJP and Congress, except in UP where the Congress will ally with Akhilesh Yadav's SP. The Congress is facing a fundamental question of relevance, no longer the default opposition pole. Recent events, such as the AAP losing Rajya Sabha MPs to the BJP and the CPI(M) shrinking to one state, have shifted the political landscape. The BJP aims to convert national strength into uniform regional presence, while the Congress needs to improve its standalone performance to remain a key player. The party's ability to get its act together will be crucial in upcoming electoral battles.

stories.headline: Effective Coalition Or Paper Tiger? The Split Reality Of The Anti-BJP INDIA Bloc
stories.summary: The INDIA bloc, a coalition of opposition parties, appears united in Parliament but is divided at the state level, with regional parties and Congress competing against each other. Despite their collective efforts, the bloc's tally in 2024 is similar to the Opposition numbers in 2014. The BJP's recent wins in assembly elections have gained them momentum. Grand alliances in Bihar, Maharashtra, and West Bengal are at risk, with Congress considering switching allies in West Bengal. Mamata Banerjee, leader of the Trinamool Congress, has called for a joint platform of opposition parties to challenge the BJP, following her party's loss of governance in West Bengal. The opposition bloc faces challenges in seat-sharing and campaign strategy, making their unity and effectiveness uncertain. The BJP's growth has put pressure on the opposition to form a strong and united front.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty rebound; RIL leads gains Indian benchmark equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, rebounded on Wednesday, recovering intraday losses, primarily driven by strong fag-end buying and a significa
stories.summary: Indian benchmark equity indices, Sensex and Nifty, rebounded on Wednesday due to strong fag-end buying and a sharp rally in Reliance Industries. The Sensex jumped 397.17 points, or 0.87%, to 46,005.68, while the Nifty 50 benchmark index also gained. The rebound recovered intraday losses, driven by buying in blue-chip stocks. The gain in Reliance Industries led the rally, contributing to the overall rise in the indices. The improvement in global sentiment, following a decline in crude oil prices and signals of de-escalation in the Middle East conflict, also supported the rebound. The Nifty 50 moved above significant levels, reclaiming 24,000 amid an oil price surge, indicating a positive trend in the Indian stock market. The weekly expiry of derivative contracts also played a role in the market's movement.

stories.headline: Sensex drops 600 points, Nifty below 23,450. 6 key factors behind today's D-St rout Indian stock markets experienced a sharp downturn on Wednesday, with both Sensex and Nifty declining approximately 0.8%. The Sensex dropped over 600 points to b
stories.summary: Indian stock markets experienced a sharp downturn on Wednesday, with the Sensex dropping over 600 points and the Nifty falling below 23,450. The decline represents a roughly 0.8% decrease for both indices. The Sensex and Nifty had previously shown gains, with the Sensex up over 117 points at 75,318 and the Nifty 50 up 41 points at 23,659. However, the market reversed, with the Sensex declining more than 600 points to drop below 74,600 and the Nifty 50 falling over 190 points. The India VIX, which measures volatility in markets, also played a role in the downturn. The decline is attributed to weak global cues and market volatility, with six key factors contributing to the rout in the Indian stock markets. The exact factors behind the decline are not specified, but they have significantly impacted the market's performance.

stories.headline: Stock Market Bloodbath: Sensex Down Nearly 600 Points Amid Global Selloff GIFT Nifty was trading at 23,421 in early morning trade, down 143 points or 0.61 percent., Markets, Times Now
stories.summary: The Indian stock market experienced a significant decline, with the Sensex down nearly 600 points amid a global selloff. The Sensex was trading at 74,614.22, a decrease of 586.63 points or 0.78%. The Nifty 50 also dropped, with the GIFT Nifty trading at 23,421 in early morning trade, down 143 points or 0.61%. This downturn follows a trend of losses in the Indian stock market, with the Sensex previously plunging 2496.89 points to close at 74,207.24 and the Nifty 50 dropping 775.65 points. The market's decline is attributed to weak global cues, leading to a massive sell-off in Indian stock markets.

stories.headline: Stock markets open in red, Sensex tank over 500 pts, Nifty down to 23K Indian benchmark equity indices, the BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty, experienced a significant drop in early trade due to elevated oil prices, weak global market tren
stories.summary: Indian benchmark equity indices, the BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty, plummeted in early trade due to elevated oil prices and weak global market trends. The BSE Sensex tanked over 500 points, while the NSE Nifty fell below 23,000. Brent crude oil prices surged to $110.8 per barrel, contributing to market weakness. The decline was led by IT and financial stocks. India's reliance on imported crude oil, accounting for over 85% of its requirements, makes domestic markets highly sensitive to global energy price shocks. The market downturn was also influenced by Middle East tensions and a national fuel price hike. The GIFT Nifty was down 150 points, signaling a weak start for the Sensex and Nifty, as investors remained cautious amid the crude oil crisis. The sharp decline reflects the market's vulnerability to global economic trends.

stories.headline: FedEx breaks ground on Clark facility expansion project
stories.summary: FedEx has broken ground on the expansion of its Clark gateway facility in the Philippines, aiming to strengthen the country's position as a key shipping hub in Asia. The upgraded facility will cover over 78,000 square meters and feature enhanced handling and operational capabilities to improve shipment flow reliability and service flexibility. The expansion will boost FedEx's capacity to support express, e-commerce, and freight shipments, driving growth for domestic and cross-border trade. The project modernizes and enlarges the existing facility, doubling down on the Philippines as a key logistics and trans-shipment hub in Asia amid booming cross-border trade and e-commerce demand. Once complete, the facility will improve shipment reliability and service flexibility for customers, solidifying the Philippines' role in the region's logistics industry. The expansion is part of FedEx's growth strategy in the Philippines.

stories.headline: Europe’s EV Sales Surge as Oil Shock Hits Drivers
stories.summary: Electric vehicle sales in Europe have surged, with a 30% year-on-year increase, driven by high fuel prices linked to the Iran war. New EV registrations rose 34% in April, while used EV demand also saw a sharp increase. The European Union reported a 13.7% jump in new car sales in April, with nearly half of them being electrified. This shift towards electric vehicles is attributed to the high gas prices, which have triggered an irreversible move away from gas-powered cars. The sales surge is not limited to new vehicles, as used EV demand has also risen significantly, indicating a broader trend towards electrification in the European market. The first quarter of 2026 saw a notable increase in EV sales across Europe, as drivers seek alternatives to high fuel prices.

stories.headline: Nvidia's Earnings Are Hours Away. Here Are 3 Things to Watch.
stories.summary: Nvidia is set to report its fiscal first-quarter earnings after Tuesday's closing bell. Investors will be watching the company's outlook for the quarter ahead, its transition to the Vera Rubin chip, and any commentary on the China market. Nvidia's growth story is supported by its position in the AI chip market, but its shares have a price-to-earnings ratio of about 45, making them relatively expensive. In its previous quarterly report, Nvidia beat expectations and provided a strong forecast for the current quarter. Investors will be looking for updates on new products and their impact on the company's financials. The earnings report will provide insight into Nvidia's performance and future prospects, with key takeaways expected to influence the stock's direction. Nvidia's Q3 earnings, reported in November, showed strong results, and investors are awaiting the latest update.

stories.headline: China ternary precursors exports down 79.3% in April
stories.summary: China's exports of ternary precursors plummeted 79.3% in April. In 2025, the country's cumulative exports of ternary precursors totaled 72,446 tonnes, a 47.5% year-on-year decrease. Notably, NCM ternary precursors accounted for the entire export volume of 4,446 tonnes in April. Previously, China's exports of NCM ternary precursors had risen 37.2% to 81,649 tonnes from January to November, while NCA shipments increased 1.4% to 6,868 tonnes during the same period. The significant decline in April's export volume marks a shift in the market, potentially influenced by the removal of export rebates and changes in global demand for advanced battery materials, particularly from the European electric vehicle market.
